note: Fix k. The LHS partitions length-(2k+1) binary words with at least k+1 ones according to j, the number of zeros before the (k+1)-st one. Prefix count is C(k+j,j), suffix count 2^(k-j). Bit-complement pairs majority-one and majority-zero words, so the count is half of 2^(2k+1), namely 4^k. Edge case k=0 is included.
